Market.Title: Market
Market.Empty: No shops are open for business right now.
Market.EmptyGM: No shops are visible to players yet. Use Edit Shops to create one and make it visible.

Themes.Heading: Market Theme
Themes.Subheading: Pick how shop rows look in the Market. This applies to everyone in the world.
Themes.UsesAccentHint: This theme uses each shop's accent colour.
Themes.SampleDesc: Potions, tonics, and unlabeled things that bubble.
Themes.CinematicHint: Full-bleed art behind a dark scrim, with a slow zoom.
Themes.TomeHint: Parchment and gilt rules, like a page from a spellbook.
Themes.SignHint: Carved wood and brass rivets that sway when hovered.
Themes.ArcaneHint: Frosted glass with a coloured halo and a light sweep.
Themes.ChalkHint: Slate in a wooden frame, chalked by hand.
Themes.BannerHint: Hanging cloth with a shield badge in the shop's colours.
Themes.GlassHint: Leaded cathedral panes lit from behind.
Themes.HazeHint: Drifting violet mist over the storefront. Dark fantasy.
Themes.CrateHint: Stencilled smuggler's crate with iron banding.

Shop.InventoryEmpty: This shop has nothing in stock.
Shop.NotEnoughCoinBody:
You don't have enough coin to complete this purchase.

Total cost: {cost} gp
You have: {have} gp
Shop.NotEnoughStockBody: The shop no longer has enough of {name} in stock.
Shop.NoActorBody: You don't have a character assigned, so you can't make purchases. Ask your GM to assign you one.
Shop.NoGMBody: A Gamemaster needs to be online to process purchases. Please try again later.
Shop.PurchaseTimeout: The purchase request timed out. Please try again.

Framing.Heading: Image Framing
Framing.Hint: Drag to pan, scroll or use the slider to zoom
Framing.ShopImageHint: Used by the shop page and the thumbnail in the market row
Framing.BannerHint: Used by themes that stretch the art across the whole row
Framing.FitWholeHint: Never crop — scales the picture to fit and fills the gap with a blurred copy

Tools.CountHint: How many items to roll from the table
Tools.NoTables: There are no rollable tables in this world.
Tools.TableMissing: That rollable table could not be found.
Tools.TableFailed: Rolling on that table failed — see the console for details.
Tools.TableNoItems: Rolling on "{table}" produced no items. Does the table contain item entries?
Tools.TableShort: The table ran out of item results before reaching {wanted}.
Tools.DropOnlyItems: Drop an item to add it, or a rollable table to populate from it.
Tools.GeneratePricesHint: Roll prices for every item currently priced at 0, based on its rarity.
Tools.PricesGenerated: Priced {priced} item(s). {unchanged} already had a price.
Tools.PricesSkipped: {count} item(s) have no magic rarity and are still 0 gp — they will be FREE to buy: {names}
Tools.AllPriced: Every item already has a price ({count} total).
Tools.NothingToPrice: This shop has no items to price.
Tools.ClearConfirmBody:
Remove all {count} item(s) from {name}?

This only takes effect once you click Save.
Tools.Cleared: Removed {count} item(s). Click Save to apply.
Tools.FreeWarning: Some items are priced at 0 gp and will be free for players to take.
Tools.FreeItemHint: This item is free at 0 gp.

Edit.Title: Edit Shops
Edit.DeleteShopConfirmBody: Delete {name} and all of its inventory? This cannot be undone.
Edit.DropHint: Drag items here from the sidebar, a compendium, or an actor sheet
Edit.SelectShopHint: Select a shop on the left, or create a new one.
